rules: Discovery of another claimant does not auto-transfer ownership.
Overlapping claims generate diplomatic/legal dispute state, not automatic war.
Possible peaceful outcomes include recognition, withdrawal, shared access, joint colony, corridor, neutral zone or negotiated boundary.
A military escalation candidate may be emitted only from later explicit actions; Block 2 never resolves war.
Claims and effective control are reported independently to diplomacy.
Existing treaties/recognition constrain valid settlement and border outcomes.
